title: YOUVA EdAI Permanent Human-Only Policy Controls
description: Defines the 8 immutable human-only controls where automated AI execution is permanently forbidden.

controls.name: Student Mastery Certification
controls.description: Formal attestation that a student has mastered a curriculum unit or competency standard.

controls.name: Parental/Guardian Consent Scope Modification
controls.description: Any change to the scope, permissions, or boundaries of parental or guardian consent.

controls.name: Parental/Guardian Consent Revocation & Data Erasure Request
controls.description: Revocation of consent initiating immediate session termination and scheduled cryptographic purge.

controls.name: User Role & RBAC Privilege Elevation
controls.description: Elevation or modification of user persona or permission tier (e.g., student to teacher, teacher to admin).

controls.name: Child Safety Escalation Incident Resolution & Closure
controls.description: Closure, dismissal, or resolution of any flagged child safety, self-harm, or safeguarding incident.

controls.name: Verifiable Credential & Open Badge Issuance Authorization
controls.description: Final authorization and signing of portable W3C VC 2.0 credentials and Skills Passports.

controls.name: AI Model Autonomy Boundary & Budget Allocation Modification
controls.description: Expanding model action space, raising FinOps token budget limits, or altering drift thresholds.

controls.name: Multi-Jurisdiction Regulatory Profile Activation
controls.description: Promoting a jurisdiction profile from draft/review to active status for live tenant routing.
